# Lessons (발췌 — 시나리오 시점 기준)

## 13 — Integrate news sentiment, valuation, and structural vs. noise diagnosis into every decision
Every decision must weigh: (1) news sentiment, (2) overbought/oversold, (3) valuation vs targets,
(4) noise vs structural change — alongside technicals.

## 15 — The same analyst making the same point is ONE signal, not three
Repeated headlines re-stating one analyst's view do not warrant repeated action.
If the answer is "it's the same analyst making the same point," filter it out.

## 16 — AI/semi supply chain sells off as a coordinated unit on hyperscaler capex doubt
A first-order AI-infra guidance miss (AVGO/MRVL) cascades 7-14% across every layer within
1-2 sessions. Do NOT dip-buy the initial cascade; defend exposed holdings first.

## 17 — On binary-catalyst days, pre-empt the armed exit when the adverse resolution confirms in real time
If (1) adverse news confirmed, (2) 3x+ volume distribution from the session high, (3) MACD hist
negative throughout, (4) price within 1 ATR of the formal trigger — pre-empt; don't wait for the close.

expectation.note: defend into the cascade; BUY here would violate lesson #16
